record.dic_text:
0813 'Ashk@naz {ash-ke-naz'}

源自外來語; 陽性專有名詞 人名或國名

欽定本 - Ashkenaz 3; 3

亞實基拿 = "像灑落的雨滴般的人: 撒落般的火"
1) 雅弗的後裔 (#創 10:3; 代上 1:6|)
2) 一個北方的民族, 可能是俾斯尼亞 (在小亞細亞西北, 濱黑海的一個古國) (#耶 51:27|)
record.edic_text:
0813 'Ashk@naz {ash-ken-az'}

of foreign origin;; n pr m

AV - Ashkenaz 3; 3

Ashkenaz = "a man as sprinkled: fire as scattered"
1) a descendant of Japheth
2) a northern people, perhaps of Bithynia
